import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('tri-star on stairs + worm brake')
# stairs
for i in range(3):
    x0=i*0.28; y0=-i*0.17
    ax.plot([x0,x0+0.28],[y0,y0],'k-')
    ax.plot([x0+0.28,x0+0.28],[y0,y0-0.17],'k-')
# cluster center and 3 wheels
import math
cx, cy = 0.30, 0.10
R=0.13
for k in range(3):
    a=math.radians(90+k*120)
    wx=cx+R*math.cos(a); wy=cy+R*math.sin(a)
    c=plt.Circle((wx,wy),0.075,fill=False,lw=2); ax.add_patch(c)
    ax.plot([cx,wx],[cy,wy],'k-')
ax.plot([cx],[cy],'ko')
ax.text(cx+0.02,cy+0.02,'axle+worm brake')
ax.text(0.05,0.35,'load frame')
ax.plot([cx,0.05],[cy,0.35],'k-')
ax.text(0.30,-0.35,'150mm wheels, 170 rise 280 going')
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120)
